parsed.rationale: Both participating records are test/mock fixtures. The first record resides in 'Shared/PartyHorn/Tests/PartyHornTests/SoundPlayerTests.swift' (a test file) and the second in 'Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTestUtilities/Mocks/MockAudioSession.swift' (explicitly under a Mocks directory). Per the decision rules, any cluster where a participating record is a test or mock fixture warrants no-action, and here both records carry that character. Consolidating these mock types across package boundaries would couple unrelated test packages and undermine test isolation.
